title: Device adjustment
description: Adjustment of one profile rule on one device: only for rules that are not fixed in the profile, never against a boundary. At most one per device and rule. A temporary adjustment (expires_at) is deleted by the hub at its end (audit override_expired, author = the hub), and the profile value applies again. The hub deletes an adjustment that equals the profile value and every adjustment of a rule that becomes fixed (with preview).

user_choice.description: true = the person at the device decides (rules with user_choice_allowed); value is the starting value.

created_by.description: Display name of who set it: admin, or the family manager device.

created_by_client_id.description: Family manager device that set it (origin family_manager), else null or missing.
